subject: test(cursor): Fix race in DestructionObeysBackgroundCleanupSetting (#1511)
reason: The change modifies only a unit test file (testing/ft_cursor_test.cc), suspending the utility thread pool to remove a race in the DestructionObeysBackgroundCleanupSetting test's assertions. No production code in the valkey-search module is touched, so the built module at the change is behaviourally identical to the parent; there is no runtime path a fuzzer scenario could reach or compare.
